testCaseName: Add Least Price Item to Cart
description: As a shopper on Amazon, I want the system to automatically identify the least-priced item from the search results and add it to my cart, so that I can quickly purchase the most affordable option without manually comparing prices.
steps: Navigate to Amazon and search for a product such as "iPhone 16 Plus".
Retrieve all visible items from the search results.
Compare the item prices and identify the lowest-priced item.
Add the selected item to the cart.
Verify the confirmation message or cart page shows the selected item.
expectedResult: The lowest-priced item from the search results is selected and successfully added to the cart, and the user sees confirmation that the item is in the cart.
